_comment: Checks for ~/.claude/workflows/director.js. Run each from a worktree root; proven green on origin/main 13f37d3 (2026-09-30).
Where Docker's credential helper can't run (WSL interop off), prefix each with `export DOCKER_CONFIG=<dir with {"auths":{}}>;`.

CHECK_SUITE is the same `docker compose run --rm checks` that CLAUDE.md and checks.yml use (every gate: typecheck, lint, the audits, 729 jest tests, iOS bundle, web export + colour gate, QR decode, 540 Playwright journeys). About 3 minutes.
Three lanes skip LOUDLY without credentials (lane E RLS, auth config drift, live auth settings). The director's workers never hold secrets, so those stay with the owner.

-p runit-wf keeps the dev stack's volumes untouched; every compose call must keep it, or each worktree leaks a network. -v /app/node_modules gives each run its own install, so parallel worktrees never race on the shared volume; the pnpm store stays shared (content-addressed). -v $G:$G:ro lets git resolve a worktree's .git inside the container.
image: runit-checks:local is a fixed tag shared with the main checkout, so a worktree that changes docker/checks.Dockerfile and runs CHECK_IMAGE retags the image the main checkout uses.
While the re-spec sprint's work sits unmerged on claude/exciting-planck-umrj5a (see #1), run the director with base: origin/claude/exciting-planck-umrj5a for that work.
panel.class "public" mirrors ~/.config/panel/classes.json; panel_gate.py uses the stricter of the two, so this can never loosen what the map allows.

checks.CHECK_SUITE: G=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir); docker compose -p runit-wf run --rm -T -v /app/node_modules -v "$G":"$G":ro checks
